data.desc: Satellos is a clinical-stage drug development company focused on restoring natural muscle repair and regeneration in degenerative muscle diseases. Through its research, Satellos has developed forazapadin, an orally administered small molecule AAK1 inhibitor designed to address deficits in muscle repair and regeneration. Forazapadin is being evaluated as a potential disease-modifying treatment for Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) in two Phase 2 clinical trials, BASECAMP in pediatric participants with DMD and TRAILHEAD in adults living with DMD. Following FDA clearance of an Investigational New Drug (IND) application, a Phase 2 clinical trial of forazapadin in adults with facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD) is expected to begin in the fourth quarter of 2026.
